title: From Fallen Tree to Finished Oak Bowl
summary: Opens on the finished oak bowl, then follows raw blank to lathe shaping, sanding glow, and food-safe oiling to the ready-to-use piece.

segments.label: Finished bowl opener
segments.reason: Opens with 'This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table.' then 'It started as a rough blank from a fallen tree.' Strongest hook for 60-second highlight. Editor: Opens strong on the finished oiled bowl to hook, then teases it started as a rough blank.

segments.label: Raw blank intro
segments.reason: Says 'Here is the raw oak blank still wet and heavy.' then 'the grain tells me where the bowl wants to be.' Establishes starting material. Editor: Establishes the starting material as wet heavy raw oak blank.

segments.label: Lathe shaping demo
segments.reason: Says 'On the lathe the shape appears in long steady cuts.' then 'I keep the wall wall thickness even from rim to base.' Clear making step. Editor: Shows first making step with long steady lathe cuts and even walls.

segments.label: Sanding glow turn
segments.reason: Says 'Sanding goes from coarse to fine with the lathe turning slowly.' then 'this is where the grain starts to glow' Turning point in finish. Editor: Shows next making step where coarse-to-fine sanding makes grain glow.

segments.label: Oiled ready ending
segments.reason: Says 'a coat of food safe oil brings out the color.' then '24 hours later the bowl is ready to use' Ideal ending on finished piece. Editor: Shows oiling step bringing out color and bowl ready after 24 hours.

segments.label: Cut and thickness
segments.reason: Says 'on the lathe lathe the shape appears in long steady cuts.' then 'I keep the wall thickness even from rim to base.' Editor: Reinforces lathe shaping detail to keep making steps clear; start moved back to sentence start at 59.4 s.

segments.label: Sanding to glow
segments.reason: Says 'sanding goes from course to fine with the lathe turning slowly.' then 'this is where the grain starts to glow.' Editor: Reinforces sanding-to-glow turning point before final finish.

segments.label: Oil to ready
segments.reason: Says 'a coat of food safe oil brings out the color.' then '24 hours later the bowl is ready to use.' Works alone as short ending. Editor: Ends closed on the finished oiled bowl ready to use.
